judgments.reason: The Dortmund Vital Study protocol describes the broader multi-domain cohort study the resting-state EEG dataset likely belongs to, but it is not this dataset's own data paper.
judgments.paper_title: Impact of Biological and Lifestyle Factors on Cognitive Aging and Work Ability in the Dortmund Vital Study: Protocol of an Interdisciplinary, Cross-sectional, and Longitudinal Study
